name: Knockout!
summary: Knockout! is a boxing game your goal; Become world heavyweight champion. To do this you first have to become European champion. Before fights you can choose the stamina of your boxer and the computers between one and four, with one being the strongest. There is also a two-player option, which consists of just a fight between both fighters. The last option you have is the ability to create an opponent. This allows you to move the boxer around the ring, throw punches and defend yourself with a limited number of moves before you have the chance to fight him. The fights themselves are viewed from the side, with the entire ring visible on the screen and you taking control of the boxer in the red pants on the right.
